remarks: Centrally located in the coveted Library Square neighborhood of Sherman Oaks, this charming single-story traditional offers 3 bedrooms and 2 baths, blending timeless character with thoughtful updates. The living room features a picture window overlooking the front garden, while the expansive great room boasts a soaring vaulted ceiling, cozy gas fireplace and skylights that fill the space with natural light. The remodeled kitchen features stainless steel appliances and the primary suite offers a generous closet and en-suite bath. Sliding doors from both the great room and primary suite open to the inviting backyard, where a sparkling pool creates the perfect setting for indoor-outdoor living
